Hi Marissa / Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo today — the team (product + infra) left with a good sense of Redwood's latency profile and price/performance. We'd like to kick off the formal security review so we can move to procurement. A few items to flag from our side: 

- Economic buyer: Tom Leary (CFO) will lead commercial approval but he wants security and procurement signoff in parallel.

- Compliance: SOC 2 attestation and a data retention policy for PII (30 days) are must-haves.

Could you share your security questionnaire and an initial suggested scope (what Redwood requires as in-scope vs out-of-scope systems)? Also please confirm procurement steps and a rough timeline so we can coordinate Tom and our procurement team.

Appreciate it — Emily
